result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. The change is one added condition in `getAllTeams()` in `LandscapeAnalysisResults.java` (the `if (!added[0] && …)` check near line 746). Unmatched contributors are added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true.

- **Dormant contributors:** they no longer go into the remainder, so they are left out.
- **Blank latest-commit dates:** these already count as active in `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, so nothing extra was needed.
- **Configured teams:** the code that adds members to them is unchanged, so they keep all their members.

The module compiles. I did not run any tests or add a new one.
